title: fix(app-shell): flow list field reads a stored string as a one-entry list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FoS954UD49NiRcXvuTYghQ)_
Fixes #25999

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Studio's flow inspector draws a notify node's `channels` with `FlowStringListField`. The spec types `channels` as `string | string[]` (`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`), and the runtime's `toStringList` in `notify-node.ts` reads `channels: 'email'` as `['email']`. The field read any non-array value as an empty list, so a stored `'email'` showed as "no entries" and adding a channel saved a list without `email`.

`FlowStringListField` now reads its value through `toList`: a list as before, a non-blank string as one trimmed entry (the same normalisation the runtime applies), anything else as empty. No spec change.

## Write-back form

**An edit writes the list form.** When the author adds, removes or edits an entry, the field commits `['email', 'sms']`, never the bare string. The spec and the runtime accept both forms, and the list form is the one every other list-valued key of the inspector writes. A field the author never touches commits nothing, so a stored string stays a string until it is edited.

## Tests

`FlowStringListField.stringValue-25999.test.tsx`, seven cases read from the rendered rows and the committed value: a string shows as one row, adding a second keeps the first (`['email', 'sms']`), removing the only entry commits `undefined`, the string is trimmed, a blank string reads as empty, a list still reads as its rows, and rendering commits nothing.

- Run at `0a84c545` under the verify lock, with the two neighbouring inspector suites: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 16 passed (16)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation (deleting the string branch of `toList` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, restore verified blob equals HEAD): 4 of the 7 cases go red (shows, keeps, removes, trims), the 3 cases about lists, blanks and no-commit stay green, as expected.

## Gates

- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `0a84c545`: 34 families, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` re-run: `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is byte-identical, because `ui/packages/app-shell` is not among the registry's source packages. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0. So the record file is not in this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- `FlowObjectListField.tsx` (around line 764) reads a nested `stringList` / `numberList` column the same way, with any non-array read as `[]`. No spec key that renders there is known to accept a bare string, so this is an observation only, not changed here. Carrier: none.
- No `ui/.github/**` or root CI workflow file is touched.
